lines.text: What prevents the internet from crashing when a massive hurricane knocks out power to cloud data centers?
Massive facilities housing hundreds of thousands of servers are built like impenetrable digital fortresses.
The instant city utility power flickers, giant Flywheel or battery Uninterruptible Power Supply systems take over instantly.
They bridge the gap without losing a single watt of electricity to server racks.
Within fifteen seconds, enormous two-megawatt locomotive diesel generators roar to life outside.
These generators have enough on-site underground fuel reserves to power a small city for days.
The cloud stays online because data centers refuse to let electricity ever die.
